tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Fresh new production-quality transparent RGBA illustration: ONE full-body single pose of the exact Indiana Bat adopted in image1. Image1 is identity/style/proportion reference only, not an edit target. Highest native resolution available. Preserve precisely its head-to-torso ratio, torso length/thickness, face, eye format, palette, warm brown line character, gentle clean watercolor paper texture, distinctive markings, horns/ears/bill/tail and original limb count. Generous transparent margins around each complete subject. No text, labels, border, grid lines, floor, shadows, background, props, clothing, effects, sparkles or extra animals. Keep the lightly anthropomorphic upright short-legged mascot and original arm-like forelimbs; do not revert to a natural quadruped. All subjects use the SAME head/body size and body reference; only the specified gesture changes. Do not fit or enlarge bent poses. 1 PRESENT_LEFT: Indicate viewer LEFT with gaze and a connected existing forelimb/wing/fin; clearly leftward teaching gesture, both feet supported where present. Species constraints: 翼の他に人の腕・手を追加しない。飛び上がりは描かず、翼膜の指骨を細密化しすぎない。 Finish with clear clean face/contours and connected complete appendages, without smudges, patchy pigment blobs, doubled parts, jagged alpha halos or clipping. Open eyes preserve reference design with no new glints. Every single part stays visible within its own transparent area. This replaces only the listed failing pose(s); preserve the reference identity and do not create other states. CRITICAL DIRECTION: Unmistakably point VIEWER LEFT using the wing on the LEFT side of this picture extended toward its LEFT edge; eyes also attend LEFT. The other wing rests. Two wings total and two hind feet, no human hands.
